1818-1981-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1818-1981-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

4279-4976-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

728-1202-2113-3249.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1202-2113-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

856-2558-6748-8095.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-2558-6748-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Repeat.

5805-8095--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5805-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

4050-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

2557-6441-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Parallel Lives and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
2557-6441-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2438-5220-7729-7855--180.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
2438-5220-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-2122-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2511-3276-5038-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat as needed.

2232-3661-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {2} at most if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-3661-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Treasures.
2232-3661-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {6}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {6} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {2} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
If needed, activate up to two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C} for each one sacrificed.
Repeat.
2232-3661-4541-5705.notes: If you control seven or more Treasures, use at least seven Treasures to cast Marut. If you use eight Treasures, forego step 13.

1651-5184-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

2018-2092-4050-7216.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter, adding {W}.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Moonlit Lamenter from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a flying counter on it.
Activate Moonlit Lamenter by paying {W} and removing the flying counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2533-4681-6798-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Chameleon.
Repeat.

2281-2438-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

250-730-779-1479-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-730-779-1479-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-4428-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-4428-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1167-2580-6108.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
As the opponent, activate Lethal Vapors by paying {0} an arbitrarily large number of times, causing that opponent to skip that many turns.

631-2921-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
631-2921-6249--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2457-2557-4289-5223.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1069-3552-4068-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-4068-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

282-2034-2751-4404.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2034-2751-4404.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Strionic Resonator and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Corridor Monitor token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3821-6056.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1170-3821-6056.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Agoraphobia by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Agoraphobia spell.
Activate Agoraphobia by paying {2}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

864-969-1312-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-4144-4314.notablePrerequisites:
It is your upkeep step.
You control at least three artifacts.
2034-4144-4314.description:
During your upkeep, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kuldotha Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Kuldotha Phoenix dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kuldotha Phoenix by paying {4}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

618-2034-4783.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-2324-4875-5170.notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Dragon" chosen with Conspiracy.
2292-2324-4875-5170.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
Junji dies, triggering itself and Proper Burial.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Junji's toughness.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2060-2854-3062-4518.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-3062-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Kor Skyfisher triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

2051-4011-4377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
2051-4011-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, taking an extra turn after this one.
On your next draw step, use Life from the Loam's dredge ability by milling three cards, returning it from your graveyard to your hand instead of drawing.
In your main phase, cast Life From the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning three Islands from your graveyard to your hand.
Play three Islands.
Repeat each turn until you have too few cards left in library to pay Life from the Loam's dredge cost.

391-1671-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-1671-4222.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
